turns.answer_excerpt: The purpose of the ASR Level 1 Wide Area Assessment is to conduct a preliminary survey of an affected area [1]. This assessment aims to determine the incident's scope and magnitude, identify the location and types of damage, and estimate urgent resource needs [1]. turns.answer_excerpt: The Level 2 Worksite Triage Assessment is carried out to evaluate collapsed structures and pinpoint viable sites where live rescues can be performed [2]. The information gathered is used by the United Nations Coordination Centre (UCC) to rank the worksites by priority and decide which USAR teams will be assigned to each site [2]. turns.answer_excerpt: A triage point should be established at the rescue worksite and set up in consultation with the medical personnel who will handle treatment and hand‑over of victims[1]. Sources: [1] INSARAG_Vol3_Field, p. 23-23
